description: Ask an entry to call the user back, about what they want to talk about, at times that suit them. Only for entries whose actions (get_entry_sections) list request_callback. Ask the user for their name, email address and phone number. Nothing is sent by this call: the user sends it on Daawid's page, with a code Daawid emails them. Give the user the link from the answer.

actionId.description: Which of its actions of this kind (get_entry_sections), when it has several.

answers.description: Answers to the action's own questions (get_entry_sections), by their keys.

entry.description: Which entry: its ID or slug, from search or get_entry.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own key for this request: the same key and details within 24 hours give the same request.

offeringId.description: Which of the entry's offerings (get_entry_sections) it is about, if one.

preferredTimes.description: When a call suits the user: up to 3 windows. Leave out when any time does.

from.description: Start, with the user's UTC offset: "2026-11-05T09:00:00+01:00".

email.description: The user's email address, for the code and the answer. Ask them; don't guess.

name.description: The user's name. Ask them; don't guess.

phone.description: The number to call back, with its country code: "+1 212 555 0123". Ask them; don't guess.

preferredChannel.description: How they'd like to be answered, if they say.

topic.description: What the user wants to talk about, in their words and language. Don't add what they didn't say.

name: request_callback
title: Request a callback
